notes.title: Madnight 2025 Has Ended – Now the Hellish wait begins!
notes.content:
[b]The World of Agony[/b] is growing! 

Dear fans! We are pleased to announce that our universe, connecting all the games we produce, is growing even more, thanks to the Tormentor, in which you will find a lot of references to Agony, [b]Succubus[/b] , Paranoid and Nymphomaniac. 

[u]We have shown a new trailer from Nymphomaniac, presenting the Equinox club[/u] and revealed many details about how Tormentor and Nympho sharing part of the features.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/1e6e18b27cdf45c3d8dfc783c50d32ebbd3f5fd0.png[/img]


But that's not all. During Madnight 2025, we answered your questions about Sirens, Lust of God, Agony: Lords of Hell and we revealed many details about these productions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/0936d867be95b03d0ed6aec5c258f768ff28f8ff.jpg[/img]


Madnight 2025 is over, and what a night it was. 59 minutes of pure, unfiltered horror, a deep dive into Tormentor, a fight against censorship, and surprises that left our audience speechless. But this is just the beginning.

Now, Tormentor is officially on [b]Kickstarter[/b]. If you want this game to be as brutal, raw, and uncompromising as we envision, we need your support.

👉 [i][b]Follow and Back Tormentor, now on Kickstarter:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


[h2]Madnight 2025 – The Highlights[/h2]

🔴 [b]A Night of Madness[/b]
We kicked things off with a live-action sequence starring the Madmind himself, Tomek, who delivered a bone-chilling manifesto on the struggles of bringing this art form to you, the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/e9f573d0b625eafe34e9ba97e1b2da6762cbcee4.jpg[/img]You can watch it here: [url=https://youtu.be/cNs-Bfbd9CE?t=93][b]1:34[/b][/url]


🩸 [b]Tormentor Gameplay Demo & Deep Dive[/b]
For the first time, we gave a full gameplay walkthrough, exploring the main hub, showcasing mechanics, and revealing just how deep the depravity goes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cNs-Bfbd9CE&t=628

🎥 [b]Developer Interviews[/b]
The masterminds behind Tormentor joined us for exclusive interviews, revealing details and their vision for the many aspects of gameplay in Tormentor.

🔪 [b]Surprise Reveals & Teasers[/b]
We unveiled the Equinox Club update for Nymphomaniac and dropped a teaser for a mysterious new character, sending shockwaves through our community on Discord.

[h3]⚡ The Biggest Premiere in Our History[/h3]
To close the night, we made our biggest announcement yet, something that will shape the future of our studio. If you missed it, you’ll want to go back and watch it.

[previewyoutube=fdBuOCfpI5E;full]https://youtu.be/fdBuOCfpI5E[/previewyoutube]

[b]🤝 Now, It’s Your Turn – Support Tormentor[/b]

Madnight 2025 may be over, but the real fight begins now. We’re pushing boundaries, standing against censorship, and creating something truly uncompromising. If you want Tormentor to reach its full potential, we need your support on Kickstarter.

🔥[i][b] Follow and Back Tormentor when the Kickstarter launches:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


Thank you to everyone who joined us for Madnight 2025. Now, let’s bring this nightmare to life.

[b]Wishlist Tormentor and Join the Community server![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493440/TORMENTOR/

notes.title: We have an important update for you
notes.content:
Dear players,


We would like to share the current status of the project and our plans for the coming days with you.
As you know, the game's release was postponed due to the lack of a green light from the Steam reviewers.
Yesterday evening we received information from Steam, according to which Nymphomaniac is an adult-only title that cannot be released in Early Access on the Steam platform.
We were instructed to resubmit the game for review as a complete game (not Early Access).

This is feedback that we have not received before, even though we have discussed the game with the Steam team many times.

In order to meet expectations and be able to publish the game on Steam, we are currently in contact with the platform's technical support to restore the game website to its original assumptions (removing "early access" - we cant do this by ourself).

[u]Nymphomaniac will debut as a full-fledged game.[/u]
(On Steam, GoG and on Madmind online Store.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/64713c9f07ab8c0d9e3520cc0403edd0920ddfaa.jpg[/img]

The game in its current form is exactly what the steam page describes. It is a complete product, a story that has a beginning and an end and many ways in which it can be told.
Vydija's story, depending on how the player directs it, can end in several ways, or never end - we can endlessly relive subsequent days with Vydija, date partners, sell our VHS recordings on the Internet and... simply live.


Of course, the fact that the game will debut as a full version does not mean that our plans to support the game are changing (the price also wont change). We hope that we will be able to support Vydija with numerous updates after the premiere, which will expand the game world and the heroine's story with new threads and adventures.

At the same time, we would like to put an end to the rumors - no, the game does not have any technical problems that prevent it from passing the Steam review.
We have not received any objections to the content of the game and we do not censor it. Nobody demands or expects this from us.

We are not sure how long it will take to change the game's Steam card and finally get permission to release it, but we assure you that our actions and responses are lightning fast.

We use this extra time to polish and test the game. We cooperate with an external testing team that constantly tests the latest builds with us.

We hope that this whole process will not take long and we will soon be able to give Vydija into your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040892/878d46bfcc5c2cbd63c3dc85fe347e68780eff5d.gif[/img]


Keep your fingers crossed and catch us on discrod :)

/Madmind

1. Buy Paranoid [b][u]before[/u][/b] the release of Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict.
2. Go to your Steam profile page in a web browser. 
3. Copy the link to your profile.
4. Make sure your game library is public (on August 26-28) so we can verify ownership of the game.
5. Make sure that your profile on August 26-28 contains the email address from which you are sending the message. For example: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/ab04485a8df75886ea65a35a79cf79064f37e273.jpg[/img]

- Enter "To My Beloved Vydija" in the email subject
- insert a link to your Steam profile
- type "I own the Paranoid game and would like to receive a free Steam code for Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict."
- type "I consent to the processing of e-mail addresses by Madmind Studio S.A. for the duration of the promotion."

7. Done!
Vydija will respond to your message on the day of Nymphomaniac's release, sending you a code for the game. 

Of course, you can also add something from yourself in your message. Our Vydija likes to read love letters.
